description: This file defines a Presenter subclass that creates and binds UI cards representing workout items in an Android TV application. It handles visual styling, focus effects, and click interactions for workout cards.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter for displaying workout information as a styled card with focus effects in an Android TV app.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and configures the view holder with a stylized ImageCardView, including focus and click handling.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds Workout data to the card view, setting images, texts, and click callbacks.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears references in the view to prevent memory leaks.
